properties.name: cholewa.validation.english-messages
properties.description: Whether Bean Validation messages are always worded in English, regardless of the locale of the JVM or of the request. Set to false to get them localized.

properties.name: cholewa.rabbit.pod-connection-name
properties.description: Whether a RabbitMQ connection is named after the pod: the value of HOSTNAME when it starts with spring.application.name followed by a dash, otherwise the application name with the suffix -local. Set to false to keep the default name of Spring AMQP.

properties.name: cholewa.logbook.reactive-filters
properties.description: Whether Logbook logs through the reactive filters - LogbookWebFilter on the server (logbook.reactive.server-mode defaults to web-filter) and LogbookExchangeFilterFunction on every WebClient - so that its request and response lines carry the traceId and spanId of the exchange. Set to false to keep Logbook's own Netty handlers, whose lines carry no trace.

properties.name: cholewa.required-properties
properties.description: Properties the application does not start without, each as {property, variable}: when one has no value, or holds a placeholder that does not resolve, the start is refused before the first bean is created. The variable is optional and only named in the refusal. Nothing is checked without the list.
